script: You are twenty-four years old, and the army has just requisitioned you for a job with no name. Every day, before Hitler eats, you eat first. Fifteen women, three meals, at a table outside the Wolf's Lair bunker in Poland. You have fifteen minutes to see if you convulse. Nobody explains what the poison would feel like. You just wait, and watch the woman next to you, and hope neither of you drops. The food is better than anything in wartime Germany, fresh vegetables, real butter, food fit for a dictator, and you can't taste a bite of it, because it might be the last thing you ever taste. One taster is pulled aside and shot for a mistake never explained to the rest. You keep eating. For two and a half years, you eat first, every single day, for a man you never once see. When the war ends, you tell no one what your job was. Not your husband. Not your children. For sixty-eight years you carry it in silence, until an interview in 2012, months before you die, finally breaks it. The bunker where you sat is still standing in Poland today. You never found out if it was ever poisoned.

title: How Long Would You Have Survived as Hitler's Food Taster?
description:
You've just been ordered to eat before Hitler does. If it's poisoned, you're the one who finds out.
One of the fifteen women forced to test his food stayed silent about it for 68 years.
